name: Mori Misaki
source:
One of the original participants.

Although she may be timid, she tries her hardest to help Yukinari in solving problems. She speaks with a Kansai accent and sometimes stutters.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Misaki_Mori]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
